notes.title: Updates Abound! They’re all around! Build v1.1.1 is live now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/8cf970eb689a5afdc442522fa4ccedab0958acce.jpg[/img]

Hi, all! It’s been a bit since we’ve had a new update and that’s because our (very) small team has been hard at work on the Xbox release of BattleCakes and related post-launch fixes and updates. Well, mission accomplished and the good news is we can now bring all that hard work back to Steam for an even better experience here. So yeah, lots of updates all over the game and we’ve got more in the works to boot. Thanks for all your support and talk to y’all again soon!

[b]Major Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where speed buffs and debuffs were applied incorrectly to player stats.
[*] Fixed bug with hero display on Save Slot UI
[*] Fixed some biome names not showing up correctly on Save Slot UI.
[/list]
[b]Additional Updates and Smaller Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated UI for opening scene Skip option
[*] Re-worked crafting tutorial in VH Farm to make it more findable by players.
[*] Optional second Honeybun Queen encounter is now a level-up scenario.
[*] Re-balanced Butterscream HP and damage stats
[*] Re-balanced treasure chest rewards for second half of game.
[*] Added text descriptions for Might, Moxie and Magic on Level Up screen UI
[*] Fixed Defense topper in BH Dungeon not showing up in inventory.
[*] Fixed sorting and collisions in West Garnish movie set area.
[*] Fixed sorting and collisions in NH Camp-a-lot photo op setup.
[*] Fixed sorting and collisions in NH Dungeon apartment interiors.
[*] Removed duplicate text line in Topper UI describing effects.
[*] Fixed bug with customizer UI at Mousse salon.
[*] Fixed some items not being removed from inventory on quest completion in WG.
[*] Fixed bug with dulpicate Frannies in West Garnish depending no quest state.
[*] Fixed bug where Marzipan orb does not leave as it should post-dungeon.
[*] Fixed bug with topper sorting on Midnite Truffle
[*] Added scarecrow interacts and toppers
[*] Added small dumpster interacts
[*] Small increase to value of trash recycling
[*] Updated art for Wafflecone Manor kitchen hazard
[*] Added audio SFX to dungeon gate
[*] Added support skill actions for heroes
[*] Updated skill list UI and encounter UI accordingly.
[*] Added additional colors for creamhorns
[*] Fixed Melody typewriter animation in Sleep Spell Inn in MZ.
[*] Updated crumbstone assets throughout game
[*] Fixed bug with entrance to Nougat Hollow Dungeon
[*] Fixed randomized interacts in NH Marsh
[/list]

notes.title: Big Achievements Update! Build v1.0.8 is live now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/49261528d5afb17931db65d790cf1813642fe1b2.png[/img]

Ready to achieve even more? When BattleCakes first launched we had a mere four Achievements and now we've updated and expanded to sixteen. Neat! Do four times the achievements mean four times the fun? Gosh, we hope so. In addition, this build has an assortment of fixes and updates... but the Achievements is the fun bit...

[b]Major Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug preventing re-match with Butterscreams if defeated during encounter.
[/list]
[b]Additional Updates and Smaller Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] More cats!
[*] Added floating number UI when heroes hit by world hazards
[*] Fixed bug where corner HUD health meter didn't update after Health pickups.
[*] Misc collider fixes in West Garnish region
[*] Misc art updates for Nougat Hollow region
[*] Various copy edits to fix dialogue typos.
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update Coming Soon and Early Access Discount Price Ending
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/584724efbc48b6e007ce22088553469e16c9b523.png[/img]

We will be releasing our next big content update for BattleCakes this coming [b]Monday, January 29th[/b]!

[h3]What to expect in the upcoming build?[/h3]

In addition to the content updates which includes:
[list]
[*] New location! The desert town of West Garnish, the Whistling Gorge, the crystal mines and more.
[*] New NPCs! Meet the colorful cast of West Garnish and the visitors to the West Garnish Gemboree.
[*] New Dangers! Delve into the crystal mines of the West Garnish Dungeon and continue your pursuit of Lord Fondant.
[/list]
There will also be:
[list]
[*] Controller Re-mapping!
[*] Updated default keyboard controls
[*] Quest UI improvements
[*] Save Slot UI improvements
[*] And more...
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] With the upcoming build, we will also be [b]ending the discounted Early Access pricing[/b] and the game will go up to the full release price of $19.99 (USD).

Thank you to all our players and can't wait to hear what you think of the next area! There's only one more town to go after this one and then the final battle awaits! We're getting closer and closer to release, so please share your thoughts and feedback! We appreciate you! 🙂

tags.feature: New location! The desert town of West Garnish, the Whistling Gorge, the crystal mines and more.
New NPCs! Meet the colorful cast of West Garnish and the visitors to the West Garnish Gemboree.
New Dangers! Delve into the crystal mines of the West Garnish Dungeon and continue your pursuit of Lord Fondant.
Controller Re-mapping!
Updated default keyboard controls
Quest UI improvements
Save Slot UI improvements

notes.title: Build v0.9.0 live now - The Magic and Menace Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/0e81e0c9c685a297bd754d674eac1f0210f8a6ff.png[/img]

Hello, everyone! We’re so excited to have another build for you, this time continuing into the Marzipan dungeon and the many dangers that await! We had more work than expected in terms of bug fixes and some system improvements that needed to happen, so thank you all for your patience and continued feedback. It is a huge help and we appreciate you all so much!

[b]What’s new in Build v0.9.0:[/b]
[list]
[*] Marzipan dungeon levels unlocked, including the Trail of Might, Trial of Moxie and boss battle with the Gummy Wyrm.
[*] Updated Gummy Beast and Gummy Wyrm reflect actions with more obvious particle effects and visible icons.
[*] Refactored level-up UI to make sure Stat Increase and Action upgrade choices are presented directly to player post-encounter.
[*] Added stat increases for visiting with willow shrines on MZ Bridge.
[*] Added potential stat increase for completing Leena Moonberry quiz.
[*] Additional forest region and waterfall when leaving Marzipan.
[*] Short river run mini-game.
[*] A small glimpse of West Garnish.
[/list]
[b]Major Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed game breaking bug in Honeybun Queen encounter with certain encounter end conditions.
[*] Fixed conversation position in BH Theater trapping player.
[*] Fixed BH Town bush colliders when placed too close to buildings, trapping player.
[*] Fixed Midnite Truffle’s Blacklight Vortex action, bad animation call breaks game.
[/list]
[b]Additional Updates and Smaller Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made status numbers and text more clear during encounters.
[*] Fixed road colliders near Butterworth Heights wagon crossroads.
[*] Fixed colliders and sorting for Creamhorns and cheeps in BH.
[*] Fixed dialogue balloon positions for Honeybun Queen.
[*] Fixed dialogue balloon positions for Leena during quiz sequence.
[*] Added additional background NPCs and dialogue updates in MZ University
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to Marzipan, the most magical experience...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/9672f63617b07f047c7c9307d50fb7d653f4595e.png[/img]

It's here! We're so excited to announce our first big content update, allowing players to explore the magical mountain town of Marzipan!

[h2]What’s new in build v0.8.0?[/h2]

[b]New NPCs:[/b]
The cakes of Marzipan
The teachers and students of Marzipan University

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/4154a41473e19450bb4dbe165c89557d6e444108.gif[/img]

[b]New critters:[/b]
Gummy Beasts
Guardian Constructs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/2c50f4403486a454abe014b70bc061702e6dbfaa.gif[/img]

[b]New Locations:[/b]
The full Marzipan entrance bridge
The town of Marzipan itself
Marzipan University
The outskirts of the Marzipan wilds (and the ruins they contain)

We hope you have fun on this next leg of the BattleCakes adventure and as usual, please feel free to share your thoughts and feedback! We appreciate it and you! :)

notes.title: Content update coming Monday, November 13th!
notes.content:
We will be releasing the first big content update for BattleCakes this coming Monday, November 13th! Thank you to everyone who has played so far and we can't wait for you to see the new areas of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/2c50f4403486a454abe014b70bc061702e6dbfaa.gif[/img]

[h3]What to expect in the upcoming build?[/h3]
[list]
[*] New locations! Including the mountain town of Marzipan, the magical Marzipan University and the outskirts of the Marzipan wilds.
[*] New NPCs! Including the tourists and townspeople of Marzipan and the students and staff of Marzipan University. 
[*] New critters! Including the squish-tastic Gummy Beasts and the guardian Constructs of the Marzipan ruins.
[/list]
